item.title: Oil prices surge past $105 a barrel as war on Iran continues
item.description: The price for a barrel of Brent crude, the international standard, was at $101.19, while West Texas Intermediate was selling for about $107.06 a barrel.

item.title: Who is Mojtaba Khamenei, Iran's new supreme leader?
item.description: Mojtaba became the third supreme leader of the country since 1979.

item.title: Israel kills three Palestinians in Gaza, including two children, in another ceasefire violation
item.description: Israel wounded 10 others in its strike that targeted tents sheltering displaced Palestinians.

item.title: US orders embassy staff members to leave Saudi Arabia as war on Iran continues
item.description: The order comes after Saudi Arabia said two people were killed when a projectile landed in Al Kharj province.

item.title: Israel' unlawful use of white phosphorus in new Lebanon attacks 'extremely alarming': Rights group
item.description: Authorities have over the past years accused Israel of using controversial white phosphorus rounds, in attacks authorities say have harmed civilians and the environment.

item.title: Trump claims US sank Iran’s navy, destroyed most missile launch platforms
item.description: US president says Iran’s military capabilities have been severely weakened and adds decision to end the war will be made jointly with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

item.title: US, South Korea kick off major springtime military drills
item.description: The Freedom Shield exercise, which runs through March 19, is aimed at strengthening the two allies' combined defence posture.

item.title: Israel preparing for at least month-long war with Iran: Report
item.description: Israeli military’s leadership has raised the level of readiness across various combat branches, says official

item.title: Daily News Brief | 9 March
item.description: Tehran names new supreme leader as the nation fights back against Israeli and American attacks. And, Human Rights Watch reports the Israeli military unlawfully used airburst white phosphorus munitions over residential areas in Lebanon.

item.title: Footage shows US missile hitting near Iranian elementary school — report
item.description: Investigative group Bellingcat reported that a US Tomahawk missile struck near a girls’ school in Minab, based on new footage of the bombardment.
